strong_signal_anchor.primary_selection: Native adverse effect on S; no H selection or oracle-guided gate selection.
strong_signal_anchor.primary_population_recovery: Unique union of positive-effect S-selected shortlist regions, evaluated on independently generated H features; unavailable membership remains in planned-population recall.
strong_signal_anchor.secondary_population_recovery: Each selected candidate separately; D and S recovery separately; oracle-best retained candidate is diagnostic only and cannot replace primary selection.

landmark_promotion.paired_uncertainty: Bonferroni-adjusted paired bootstrap intervals over locked seeds; lower bounds must exceed zero for both families.
landmark_promotion.failure_action: Keep negative evidence and select a qualified geometric fallback. If neither representation method qualifies, the milestone remains unresolved.

null_diagnostics.diagnostic_test: One-sided exact binomial test of excess error at nominal allocation; Holm adjustment across the predeclared diagnostic panel.
null_diagnostics.intervals: Clopper-Pearson Monte Carlo intervals, including the limited resolution of 200 trials.
null_diagnostics.interpretation: Non-rejection is not proof of nominal control. Finite guarantees derive from assumptions and mathematics; simulations detect execution defects.

resource_envelope.qualification_budgets: Every method comparison records its admitted node, fit, distance, wall-time and memory budgets. Relative efficiency requires matched useful work; admission estimates are not capacity guarantees.

evidence_reuse: Lock inputs, profiles, seeds, acceptance diagnostics and dependency/function identities; reuse unaffected evidence. Fixes invalidate affected results. Method changes receive new method/evaluation identities and a new untouched qualification panel; targets are never weakened after observing failure.
dataset_policy: Record acquisition URLs, hashes, provenance and licensing. Separate natural from injected failures. Predictor preparation is benchmark-only and outside the product execution API. Do not redistribute unauthorized data.
